The linked Categories below are the ones that will be displayed on the initial page for the selected catalog on a mobile phone.
The order that they appear on the page is determined by sorting on the "Order" column first and then by the Category title.
Clicking the "Replace categories with desktop layout" link will remove all currently linked categories and add any that are available on the desktop home page for the default view of the selected catalog - these categories will be added in the order left to right and then top to bottom.
